Required behavior:
1. Add a pure exported filtering function that composes a case-insensitive, trim-tolerant query against the active-locale course title and subtitle with a level filter: all, beginner, intermediate, advanced. 6. Add focused Vitest coverage before implementation for the pure filter: locale-specific search, case/whitespace normalization, default-locale fallback, level filtering, combined filters, order preservation, and no matches. Preserve existing locale-navigation tests.
7. Add Playwright coverage in course-experience.spec.ts that proves search + level filtering, result status/no-results recovery, and a usable mobile layout using stable accessible locators. Do not use arbitrary sleeps for the new tests.
